title: The world’s money / identity montage

location.extent: Complete published video; PNG is one poster frame

slide_intent: Connect several expressions through repeated cues so viewers can recognize one brand across different situations.
strategic_value: Recurring green, heavy type and textured objects can connect Wise’s product and campaign worlds.
demonstration: A short film moves from a phone in a landscape to a street billboard, a restaurant, a floating green card and textured three-dimensional objects.
practical_value: Compare how a color and product silhouette survive changes in scene and medium.
